title: Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船
summary: 以Laura Maersk替代燃料案例，先確定熱值、效率與排放核算邊界，再比較假設燃料需求；不提供燃料調配、改裝或供給操作。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Laura Maersk’s alternative-fuel context to define heating value, efficiency and emissions boundaries before comparing hypothetical fuel demand, without blending, conversion or supply procedures. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 固定貨重與航程作比較基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Fix payload and distance as the comparison basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 固定貨重與航程作比較基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fix payload and distance as the comparison basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 固定貨重與航程作比較基準：噸公里是載重乘距離，可比較同一服務量的能源需求；空載回程會改變整個任務帳。 本步以「載運功能單位與效率」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Fix payload and distance as the comparison basis: Tonne-kilometres are payload times distance and compare energy for equal service; empty return legs change the mission ledger. Use Transport functional units and efficiency to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船實際規格：貨物m=1040 t、距離d=500 km。式 Wtransport=md，基準結果 520000 t·km。條件：單程貨重距離指標，不是機械做功，也未含空載和港口能耗。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Laura Maersk methanol container ship: Cargo m=1040 t, distance d=500 km. Formula Wtransport=md gives 520000 t·km. Conditions: One-way payload-distance indicator, not mechanical work; empty legs and port energy excluded.
steps.failure: 只用最大載重而非實際載重會美化每噸公里指標；需核對裝載率。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Using maximum rather than actual payload artificially improves per-tonne-kilometre metrics; inspect utilization. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 分別填裝載與空載航段的燃料和距離，使用同一邊界比較不同船型。 本案例另須檢查「固定貨重與航程作比較基準」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Log fuel and distance for loaded and empty legs separately and compare vessels under a common boundary. Also check that Fix payload and distance as the comparison basis and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：固定貨重與航程作比較基準。在燃料能量卡、貨物服務表與排放邊界圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加貨物質量10%，保持距離，算服務量；不得假設能耗必不變。 算式區的基準值為520000，改變後為572000 t·km。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Fix payload and distance as the comparison basis. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Fuel-energy cards, transport-service table and emissions-boundary diagram. Increase payload alone by 10%, retain distance and calculate service without assuming unchanged energy. Baseline 520000 changes to 572000 t·km. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：將替代燃料儲量列入質量帳。在燃料能量卡、貨物服務表與排放邊界圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為533，改變後為586.3 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Include alternative-fuel inventory in the mass ledger. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Fuel-energy cards, transport-service table and emissions-boundary diagram. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 533 changes to 586.3 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
